description: NaAsSe₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-20°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.09 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-20°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.10 Å. There are two inequivalent As³⁺ sites. In the first As³⁺ site, As³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of As-Se bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.48 Å. In the second As³⁺ site, As³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of As-Se bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.48 Å. There are four inequivalent Se²⁻ sites. In the first Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na¹⁺ and two equivalent As³⁺ atoms. In the second Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one As³⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄As square pyramids. In the third Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one As³⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄As square pyramids. In the fourth Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na¹⁺ and two equivalent As³⁺ atoms.
